blockchain.title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
blockchain.excerpt: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.

blockchain.title: Bitcoin in Limbo as Stocks Rebound Ahead of US Inflation Report
blockchain.excerpt: U.S. stocks rallied as oil fell, but Bitcoin hovered near $75,000 after a wave of liquidations, with Tuesday’s inflation report set to test bets on a December Fed rate hike.

blockchain.title: Mercado Bitcoin begins post-hack reopening without a timeline for withdrawals
blockchain.excerpt: Customers can view their pre-hack balances as access returns in phases. The exchange has yet to say when withdrawals will resume.

blockchain.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
blockchain.excerpt: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

blockchain.title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC
blockchain.excerpt: Operating under the SEC’s “Innovation Exemption,” the firm plans to list tokenized shares of Exodus, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital in early 2027, with the same voting and dividend rights as real stock.
